# Game Idea: Canvas Runner

A minimalist endless runner on an HTML canvas where the player controls a small square that automatically moves forward. Randomly generated spikes and gaps appear; the player must jump (spacebar) or slide (down arrow) to avoid them. Touching any obstacle or falling off the platform triggers a **lose condition** and ends the game.

**Core Mechanics**
- Continuous forward scrolling background.
- Simple controls: jump or slide.
- Increasing speed over time for difficulty.
- Score based on distance traveled.

**Why It Works on Canvas**
- Simple shapes (square, rectangles) keep rendering cheap.
- Collision detection via bounding boxes.
- All animation handled via `requestAnimationFrame`.

**Lose Condition**
- Collision with an obstacle or falling below the ground line ends the run.

1: // Minimal endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
20:   }
21:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
22:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200);
23:   const GROUND = H - 30;
24:   let speed = 3;
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let running = true;
27: 
28:   const player = {
29:     x: 50,
30:     y: GROUND - 20,
31:     w: 20,
32:     h: 20,
33:     vy: 0,
34:     onGround: true,
35:     crouch: false,
36:     draw() {
37:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0077ff';
38:       const ph = this.crouch ? this.h / 2 : this.h;
39:       // draw player with rounded corners
40:       const ph = this.crouch ? this.h / 2 : this.h;
41:       const py = this.y + (this.h - ph);
42:       const radius = 4;
43:       ctx.beginPath();
44:       ctx.moveTo(this.x + radius, py);
45:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w - radius, py);
46:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, py, this.x + this.w, py + radius);
47:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, py + ph - radius);
48:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, py + ph, this.x + this.w - radius, py + ph);
49:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + radius, py + ph);
50:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, py + ph, this.x, py + ph - radius);
51:       ctx.lineTo(this.x, py + radius);
52:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, py, this.x + radius, py);
53:       ctx.closePath();
54:       ctx.fill();
55:     },
56:     update() {
57:       if (!this.onGround) {
58:         this.vy += 0.5; // gravity
59:         this.y += this.vy;
60:         if (this.y + this.h >= GROUND) {
61:           this.y = GROUND - this.h;
62:           this.vy = 0;
63:           this.onGround = true;
64:         }
65:       }
66:     },
67:     jump() {
68:       if (this.onGround) { this.vy = -10; this.onGround = false; }
69:     },
70:     slide(start) {
71:       this.crouch = start;
72:     },
73:   };
74: 
75:   const obstacles = [];
76:   function spawnObstacle() {
77:     // random type: spike (triangle) or gap (hole)
78:     const type = Math.random() < 0.7 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
79:     if (type === 'spike') {
80:       const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
81:       const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
82:       obstacles.push({ x: W, y: GROUND - h, w, h, type });
83:     } else {
84:       // gap: visual hole in ground
85:       const w = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
86:       obstacles.push({ x: W, y: GROUND, w, h: 0, type }); // h=0 marks gap
87:     }
88:   }
89:   let spawnTimer = 0;
90: 
91:   function checkCollision(obs) {
92:     if (obs.type === 'spike') {
93:       return (
94:         player.x < obs.x + obs.w &&
95:         player.x + player.w > obs.x &&
96:         player.y < obs.y + obs.h &&
97:         player.y + player.h > obs.y
98:       );
99:     } else { // gap
100:       // player is on ground; if over gap, it's a loss
101:       const overGap = player.x + player.w > obs.x && player.x < obs.x + obs.w;
102:       return overGap && player.y + player.h >= GROUND;
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function loop() {
107:     if (!running) return;
108:     // background gradient
109:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
110:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // sky blue
111:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b0e0e6'); // light teal
112:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
113:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
114:     // ground
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
116:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND);
117: 
118:     // update and draw player
119:     player.update();
120:     player.draw();
121: 
122:     // spawn obstacles
123:     spawnTimer -= speed;
124:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
125:       spawnObstacle();
126:       spawnTimer = 100 + Math.random() * 100; // distance until next
127:     }
128: 
129:     // move obstacles
130:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
131:       const o = obstacles[i];
132:       o.x -= speed;
133:       // draw spike
134:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
135:         // draw spike as triangle
136:         ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3300';
137:         ctx.beginPath();
138:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, GROUND);
139:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
140:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, GROUND);
141:         ctx.closePath();
142:         ctx.fill();
143:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
144:         // create a gap by clearing the ground area
145:         ctx.clearRect(o.x, GROUND, o.w, H - GROUND);
146:       }
147:       // check collision
148:       if (checkCollision(o)) {
149:         running = false;
150:         // play game over sound
151:         playTone(110, 300);
152:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
153:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
154:         ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:         ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
156:         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
157:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
158:         ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}` , W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
159:         return;
160:       }
161:       // remove off-screen
162:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
163:     }
164: 
165:     // increase difficulty
166:     speed += 0.001;
167:     score += speed;
168:     // draw score
169:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
170:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
171:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
172: 
173:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174:   }
175: 
176:   // controls
177:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
178:     // play sound effects
179:     if (e.code === 'Space') { player.jump(); playTone(440, 120); }
180:     else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') { player.slide(true); playTone(220, 120); }
181:     // other keys
182:     if (e.code !== 'Space' && e.code !== 'ArrowDown') {
183:       // fallback handling for any other keys (none currently)
184:     }
185:   });
186:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
187:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(true);
188:   });
189:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
190:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.slide(false);
191:   });
192: 
193:   // start game
194:   loop();
195: })();

(End of file - total 195 lines)
</content>
